scope: Composer failed-result acknowledgement and independent accounting evidence
previous_finding: a60 browser-exit/global-kill race is repaired by bounded acknowledgement after fixture persistence; failed result remains fatal

findings.scenario: verifyFees awaits fees.verify(A) then feesB.verify(B). A failure skips B completely, yet this new failed-browser path is specifically intended to preserve independent accounting evidence for both accounts.
findings.repair: Attempt both checks before throwing, retain fixed per-role outcomes, aggregate failures after both attempts and before persist/ack. Regression A rejects/B still runs.

findings.scenario: Finally overwrites receiver deltas after listener closure without checking those final values. If a delayed service request changes counters after the earlier assertion, the persisted observation can remain passed despite nonzero final proof/send counts.
findings.repair: Capture final counters after accounting and enforce zero proof/send and clean L1 counters before persist/ack; preserve changed counter evidence and fail. Mutation test final counter changes from zero to nonzero.

limits: Child process test verifies result waiting and nonzero exit only after synthetic durable parent record; actual fixture finalization needs new failure-path regressions.
Missing acknowledgement remains bounded failure; global540s/RSS controls unchanged.
